title: The Scales That Tipped Toward Ruin
intro: In a lush and prosperous region, a thriving community let greed corrupt the marketplace. Known for skill in trade and abundance from surrounding gardens, this group faced a call to fairness and faith. Yet pride in wealth led to defiance, and a dark shadow gathered on the horizon.
clues: We were a prosperous trading community living among gardens and wooded groves.
We cheated people in measures and weights, spreading corruption in the land.
We were warned by our messenger to worship Allah alone and to give full measure.
We mocked our messenger and demanded the punishment to come if he was truthful.
We were seized by the punishment of the Day of the Shadow when a cloud overshadowed us.
I am known as the Companions of the Wood, the people to whom Shu'ayb was sent.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The People of Thamud
The Companions of the Wood
The Companions of the Trench
The People of the Elephant
The Companions of the Cave

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Giving short measure and defying our messenger
Demanding to see Allah directly at Mount Sinai
Building a tower to reach the heavens
Hiding faith secretly inside a palace
Worshipping a golden calf in the absence of Musa
trial.answer: Giving short measure and defying our messenger

location.label: Key Element
options: The sacred valley of Tuwa
The fire that was made cool and safe
The wooded grove of Al-Aykah
The cave with a sleeper's dog at its entrance
The mirrored palace of glass

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Drowned in the divided sea
Swallowed with treasures into the earth
Transformed into apes for breaking the Sabbath
Saved in an ark above the floodwaters
Destroyed by the punishment of the Day of Shadow
outcome.answer: Destroyed by the punishment of the Day of Shadow

verse: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers (26:176)
